entities.name: Győző Veres
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Győző Veres was a Hungarian weightlifter. He was born in Berekböszörmény in Hajdú-Bihar County. He was Olympic bronze medalist in weightlifting in 1960 and 1964. He was named Hungarian Sportsman of the Year in 1963.
